art_direction: 一大一小两颗柔光星体隔着弧形尘带相望，深紫底构图简约。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Compose a binary star scene with one warm pale star and a smaller cool white companion, linked visually by a faint curved dust ribbon. Keep both stars as soft luminous discs rather than spiky flares, with the larger one near the lower center and the companion above right. Use deep violet-black space and a few quiet background points. The dust arc should be thin and restrained, leaving most of the frame empty. Avoid a literal orbital diagram, dotted paths, labels, or a crowded constellation. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
